text: 宁德时代公告，公司此前审议通过回购A股股份方案，拟使用不低于200亿元且不超过400亿元自有或自筹资金，以集中竞价方式回购股份用于注销并减少注册资本，回购期限为股东会审议通过之日起12个月内。2026年9月11日，公司首次实施回购，回购股份60.43万股，占总股本的0.0131%，最高成交价331.61元/股，最低成交价330.15元/股，成交总金额约2.00亿元（不含交易费用）。后续公司将根据市场情况在回购期限内继续推进回购计划。
text_en: CATL announced that the company had previously deliberated and approved a plan to repurchase A-share shares, intending to use no less than RMB 20 billion and no more than RMB 40 billion of its own or self-raised funds to repurchase shares through centralized bidding for cancellation and reduction of registered capital, with the repurchase period being within 12 months from the date of approval by the shareholders' meeting. On September 11, 2026, the company implemented the repurchase for the first time, repurchasing 604,300 shares, accounting for 0.0131% of total share capital, with a maximum transaction price of RMB 331.61 per share and a minimum transaction price of RMB 330.15 per share, and a total transaction amount of approximately RMB 200 million (excluding transaction fees). Subsequently, the company will continue to advance the repurchase plan within the repurchase period based on market conditions.
